verdict.rationale: The pack documents many capabilities, plus a quickstart with a runnable first request and reasoning examples. Those are single-call snippets or feature descriptions, not official cookbooks or worked end-to-end tasks. No evidence shows an official cookbook, sample-app repository or multi-step tutorial a developer could adapt.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
